== Summary ==
Ordinary Japanese face with forfeit 4 for [[Bespin Motors Void Spider THX 1138 (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/starwarscollector-1/imagegallery/127305 StarWarsCollector_#1's PSA gallery], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/202736163/cJ5LfVfXJUe8y-l7SkrIlQ.jpg exact source photograph], PSA certificate 151187121.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 638, 1282, 2221)</code>. Source SHA-256 <code>5ebb40d48213187ad01bc3cbab570ebd2d1c7b98e2a621a52fd8d31798182ff8</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd., 1996, and Decipher Inc., 1997.
